scope_comparison: No complete matching proof located. Egan etal verifies finite orders and still lists95 missing orders up to10000. Sopin EasyChair8250 claims a general descent4nm->4n, but its entire section2 only supplies definitions/pointers to pigeonhole, Hadamard codes, puncturing/shortening and lattices, with no construction establishing that descent. This is a concrete missing proof step, so not counted as a full announcement without a gap. Circulant Hadamard resolution and finite-order Palomar declarations are different.
